about: North Battleford is a city in west-central Saskatchewan on the North Saskatchewan River, across from the separate Town of Battleford. Together the Battlefords form a regional hub for agriculture, highways, and First Nations communities on the prairie. About 14,000 people live in North Battleford.
seoSummary: West-central Saskatchewan city on the North Saskatchewan River, paired with neighbouring Battleford as the Battlefords hub.
